title: Adrian J. Hernandez’s CV
text:
Data Analyst & SEO Specialist | Lehi, UT

adrianjhndez@gmail.com | LinkedIn | Indeed Profile



Analytics-oriented professional with a background in performance reporting, analysis, and cross‑department collaboration. I turn messy data into clear dashboards and actionable insights using Python, SQL, and a healthy dose of curiosity. My experience spans SEO strategy, technical optimizations, and customer support—all built on strong communication, analytical thinking, and attention to detail. Fast learner who adapts quickly to new tools and technologies. Looking to join a team that uses data to drive real decisions.



Data analytics & reporting, performance metrics & KPIs, dashboard & report development, Python (Polars, Pandas, scikit‑learn), SQL, technical & process optimization, automation concepts, SEO, cross‑functional collaboration, technical & non‑technical communication.



2021 – 2026 Brigham Young University – Idaho
B.S. Computer Science (in progress)
2020 Inspire Connections
High School Diploma



Feb 2024 – Jan 2026 AI Healthcare Marketing – SEO Specialist

Analyzed performance data for 50+ client websites using Google Analytics, tracking traffic, conversions, and engagement.
Built custom dashboards and reports that improved search visibility across key metrics.
Conducted keyword research on 200+ target terms to guide content strategy.
Performed technical SEO audits (crawlability, site speed) and worked with developers on fixes.
Collaborated with content and development teams to turn business needs into scalable technical improvements.

Aug 2021 – Dec 2021 Brigham Young University – Idaho – Call Center Representative

Provided first-level technical support, analyzing and prioritizing daily incidents.
Documented issues in real‑time systems for cross‑functional resolution.
Helped minimize service disruptions during high‑priority technology events.

Oct 2020 – Apr 2021 Subway – Sandwich Artist

Served 100+ customers per week in a fast‑paced environment, ensuring order accuracy and satisfaction.
Operated point‑of‑sale systems while maintaining quality, hygiene, and safety standards.
Communicated effectively with Spanish‑speaking customers.

May 2020 – Aug 2020 Yellowstone Bear World – Food Service Worker / Ride Operator

Operated rides and managed guest safety for 500+ daily visitors.
Communicated safety procedures clearly to diverse guests, resolving concerns professionally.





Google Analytics Certification
Brigocal Academy: How to Master Local Keyword Research
Brightlocal Academy: How to Do Insightful Competitor Analysis for Local SEO
Brightlocal Academy: Google Analytics 4: Essentials for Local SEO
Brightlocal Academy: How to Create, Optimize, and Manage Google Business Profiles

(Additional data science certifications will be added upon completion of coursework.)




Languages: Python (Polars, pandas, scikit‑learn, lets‑plot), SQL
Tools: Git, VS Code, Quarto, Google Analytics, Excel
Soft Skills: Bilingual English/Spanish, cross‑team collaboration, technical communication





English — Native
Spanish — Native
